# schema): classes stay open by default and are final with --final-classes
# (checked in tests/vitest_swift_dart.rs).
input schema TopLevel {"type": "object", "properties": {"child": {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["name"]}}, "required": ["child"]}
pipeline {"lang": "swift"}

render swift {"rendererOptions": {"struct-or-class": "class"}}
render swift {"rendererOptions": {"struct-or-class": "class", "final-classes": "true"}}
